blocks.text: Atom ki electronic configuration us ke shells mein electrons ki taqseem bhi bayan kar sakti hai. Shells K, L, M, N waghaira orbitals ke principal quantum number n ke mutabiq hain, aur har ek ki makhsoos gunjaish hai: K shell (n = 1) zyada se zyada 2 electrons (1s orbital), L shell (n = 2) 8 (2s aur 2p), M shell (n = 3) 18 (3s, 3p aur 3d), aur N shell (n = 4) 32 (4s, 4p, 4d aur 4f).

blocks.prompt: Chlorine (Z = 17) aur calcium (Z = 20) ki shell configuration (2, 8, ...) likhein.
blocks.explanation: Chlorine ke 17 electrons hain: K mein 2, L mein 8 aur M mein 7, to 2, 8, 7. Calcium ke 20: 2, 8, 8, 2, kyunke M shell ke 3s aur 3p ke baad agle do electrons N shell ke 4s mein jate hain.

items: Shells K, L, M, N (n = 1 se 4) zyada se zyada 2, 8, 18 aur 32 electrons rakhte hain; sodium 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s1 hai, yani K 2, L 8, M 1.
